history.summary: IDENTITY AMBIGUITY FLAG (generic name): there are at least two Hanuman shrines in the Naharlagun area - a 'Hanuman Mandir' on NH 15/Cona at Banderdewa (JustDial: 'Nh 15 Cona Shannan Banderdewa, Itanagar', rated 4.2-4.3 with ~187-190 reviews, the most prominent Hanuman temple serving the Naharlagun region) and a 'Shiv Hanuman Mandir' in D Sector, Naharlagun (4.5, 4 reviews). This file documents the Banderdewa shrine as the most prominent match, but the CSV row cannot be pinned to it with certainty. CSV TOWN FLAG: the Banderdewa temple is ~12-15 km from Naharlagun town proper, on the NH 15/NH 52 corridor toward the Assam border; Banderdewa itself is in Papum Pare district. Documented with the corrected location. IMAGE SEARCH FAILURE: web image searches for this temple returned only generic Arunachal temple photos, so media is empty.

name: Hanuman Mandir
town: Banderdewa (CSV town 'Naharlagun' is approximate - temple is ~12-15 km from Naharlagun town on NH 15)
town_description: Banderdewa is a small border town in Papum Pare district, Arunachal Pradesh, ~15 km southwest of Naharlagun on NH 15 toward Lakhimpur, Assam. It is the main road entry point into the Itanagar capital region from Assam, and its Hanuman temple is the best-known Hanuman shrine of the Naharlagun area.

travel.road: On NH 15 near Banderdewa, about 15 km from Naharlagun town by road (verify).

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published (verify - confirm locally). Weekday morning/evening darshan typical for small shrines.
